title: Niya llätunk chimpunak apt’iri
intro: Mä chimpuw qalltawinakat juk’amp alt’at chuymanïñat sartasïna, mä destino Diosan munañaparjam qillqt’ata. Jisk’atpacha imantata ukat markapar t’unjañ thaqhir pachpa apnaqirin pirqanakapan jilsuyata, uka almax qhipharux mä jach’a misión ukar jawsatawa. Iyawsäwimpi ukat altʼat chuymani awatirin thujrupampikiw wakichtʼasipjjäna, ukatwa uka tiempon wali chʼamani apnaqeri nayraqatan saytʼasipjjäna, ukat esclavot qhespiyatäpjjañapatakiw mayipjjäna. Akapachax jupanakan kamachiparjamas sarnaqkaspa ukhamänwa — umax jaljtawayi, alaxpachax arsüna, ukat mä reinow t’unjasïna.
clues: Nayrïr urunakax axsarañamp uñt’atawa — nayampjama jisk’a wawanakax yurïwipanx mä jan khuyapt’ayasir apnaqiriw arknaqapxirïna, jupax jutïr pacharuw axsaräna.
Umampiw qhespiyatäyäta ukat tʼunjatäñ thaqkitu uka pachpa apnaqerin palaciopanwa jilsuwayta.
Mä akatjamat mä jan waltʼäwin markajat jaltjjayäta, jaya markanwa altʼat chuymani awatirir tukjjayäta.
Uka chʼamani apnaqiriruw mä sanu thujrumpi ukat mä qhana yatiyäwimpi uñkatañatak kuttʼanjjayäta, markajan libre sarnaqapjjañapatakiw mayïna.
Nayar arkirinakatakejj mä jachʼa umaw jaljayäta, ukat uka umajj uñisirijar taqpach manqʼantaski uk uñjarakta.
Allah sat chachan Diosan irnaqäwip katoqañatakejj mä qollan qolluruw makatayäta, ukat cheqätap uñachtʼayañatakejj llätunka qhana señalanak churapjjetäna.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic." (17:101)
